## Expected and observed behavior

Describe the difference, including whether it happens during startup, movement,
reversal, stop, reinitialization or only at particular sampling rates.

## Minimal reproducer and output

Include the smallest relevant sketch, compiler errors or Snapshot fields/flags.
For motor tests, include voltage, command and duration. Remove credentials and
unrelated personal information before attaching logs.
